teaser: My 2024 OWASP talk in Lisbon: Portuguese as a programming language, provenance, graphs instead of RAG, and the first public demo of The Cyber Boardroom.
core_idea: The June 2024 talk argued that GenAI matters because it understands, that Portuguese is a programming language because prompts are natural language, that outputs need determinism and provenance, with read-only models, your own content and graphs instead of RAG, and demoed The Cyber Boardroom explaining security to boards; two years later provenance and graphs became the newsroom's rules, models became agents that need a mandate, and Portugal released an open model for European Portuguese.

quotes.text: I think the stuff with graphs is a lot more interesting. I think you take the content, you summarize, you build graphs of it, then you navigate the graph.
Otherwise, Portugal just becomes another consumer of global technology, which is not where it should be, because now we actually have the ability to make a difference.
